audit.whatIsWrong: Five of seven level-chart rows were wrong on BOTH layers, and — worse — they contradicted the content layer's own whys. win[2] said K'Sante while whys[2] says 'his boomerang and hop beat my reach every trade'; win[3] said K'Sante while whys[3] says 'He banks the lane-control peak here'; win[5] said K'Sante while whys[5] says his poke 'still punish[es] my W cooldown before my Iceborn slow comes online'. win[4] said Gnar while whys[4] says 'Genuinely even'.
audit.why: The packet chart (Gnar, Gnar, Gnar, Gnar, Skill, Gnar, K'Sante) and the mirror audit agree exactly, and the content prose already argues that shape. The page was rendering a chart that disagreed with the paragraph directly beneath it.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 2, 3 and 5 flipped to Gnar and row 4 to Skill, each as a matched full/content pair, with ratings adjusted to the inverse of the mirror's.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two ability errors. (1) The page calls Mega Gnar's frontal AOE stun 'GNAR!' in five places. GNAR! is his R — he throws everything around him in a direction and only enemies that hit a WALL are stunned. The frontal smash-down stun is Wallop, the Mega form of W, on a flat 7s. Those are different abilities with different windows, and conflating them tells the player to track a 90/60/30s ultimate when the thing that actually punishes their W commit is off cooldown every 7 seconds. (2) 'Q3-knockup' — Ntofo Strikes' second stack fires a shockwave that PULLS. It has no knockup and no wall interaction.
audit.why: Riot's text is explicit on both: Gnar W Mega 'rear[s] up on his hind legs and smash[es] down on the area in front of him, stunning enemies in an area'; GNAR! (R) 'Any enemy that hits a wall is stunned'. K'Sante Q: 'At 2 stacks, K'Sante fires a shockwave that pulls enemies in.'
audit.corrected: Wallop named as the frontal stun with its 7s cooldown; GNAR! kept as the separate wall-stun throw; Hop given its real 22/19.5/17/14.5/12s so 'commit when his escape is down' becomes an actual timer; the pull corrected in tradeGood and dosFull[1].d.
sources: kit: Gnar W (Mega Wallop) 7s, E 22/19.5/17/14.5/12, R 90/60/30 wall-stun

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns pointed the player at 'GNAR!' as the one thing to track, with no number and a placeholder second entry.
audit.why: GNAR! is not on a trackable timer in lane — it gates on the rage bar, not a cooldown. Hop (22s at rank 1) is the real punishable window, because it is the only thing that lets a mini Gnar escape a 450-range Q.
audit.corrected: Rewritten around Hop's per-rank cooldown and the rage bar.

notes: Two systematic errors here. (1) The page treats 'GNAR!' as the name of Mega Gnar's frontal AOE stun in five places. That stun is Wallop, the Mega form of W, on a flat 7s; GNAR! is the R that only stuns enemies thrown into a wall. Telling the player to 'engage on GNAR!'s cooldown' points them at a 90/60/30s ultimate when the thing punishing them is up every 7 seconds. I fixed the load-bearing occurrences; focus.text ('Gnar GNAR!'), loading and the dosFull/report boilerplate still carry it but are under the 25-char skip or are duplicated strings. (2) Five of seven chart rows disagreed with both the packet AND the content layer's own whys sitting right beside them — flipped as matched pairs.
